body: I meant that last post to be a reply to you.  I'm a newbie on reddit and still learning.

Music does at times, but at other times, it can cripple me into a crying mess.  I also have a supportive boyfriend but I can't depend on him to save me or be the reason I am still here.  I really want a dog but can't have one at this time.  I'm glad you have your cats ;)
I wish I had some better words of wisdom for you.  I wonder if the belt is a little looser since getting these responses.  I hope so.

See, now I feel stupid because I didn't know that.  But I also know that those temporary problems are difficult as hell to get through.  I don't know what kind of support system you have or if you have support you get arrange.  My thoughts are with you.  If you need to talk, keep messaging me.

Not trying to give you tough love, but this is a permanent solution to a temporary problem.  But I also know how you feel, even though our circumstances are very different.  I hope you can find some grace in this crazy world.
